title: Bitcoin Slides Towards $81,000 as Oil Above $110 Revives Rate-Hike Bets
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Slides Towards $81,000 as Oil Above $110 Revives Rate-Hike Bets Bitcoin is currently in so-called Uptober, a month when the asset is supposed to rally. But it’s being held back — at least for now. This post Bitcoin Slides Towards $81,000 as Oil Above $110 Revives Rate-Hike Bets first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
